digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and cross-run verdict caching
propositions: Verifier budget exhausts prematurely on legitimate multi-criterion validation (epics with 6-15 acceptance criteria), falsely marking criteria unmet despite valid evidence within cost model.

Current budget formula lacks evidence-surface scaling for child-ticket traversal and fixed overhead, causing story-calibrated costs to underestimate epic criteria traversal (5-10 requests per child not reflected).
Each re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch without persisting PASS verdicts across runs, incurring ~10 min per re-verify cycle and driving operators toward attestation-laundering.

Raised defaults (24 steps/criterion, 160 floor, 960 clamp) with child-traversal term (16 steps per direct child + 16 fixed overhead) inside verify_step_floor scale budget correctly for epics while preserving runaway guards.

Scoped content fingerprint cache persists validated-PASS verdicts keyed by criterion text hash and git blob SHAs of file_impact paths, seeding subsequent runs and omitting seeded criteria from primary work surface.
Seeded PASS records bypass finalizer judgment; cache invalidates on fingerprint or criterion-text change, including file content edits, but not on unrelated commits outside file_impact scope.
